newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end down on position-squaring.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end down on position-squaring.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended down on Friday mainly on position-squaring speculators as investors kept to the sidelines ahead of the Saturday-Sunday weekend, dealers said.
"Activity remained dull today ahead of the weekend," dealer Mohammad Iqbal said. "Investors continued to stay out because of country's weak economic fundamentals."
The Karachi index fell 10.01 points, or 0.62 percent, to end at 1,593.32. Losers led gainers 175 to 66. PTCL fell 0.50 rupees to 30.75 and ICI Pakistan 0.50 to 25.05.
